name: Crystal Cavern Whale

prompt: Interior of a massive translucent geode cave at night, hundreds of amethyst crystals, a blue whale swimming through the center, bioluminescent dots, reflective puddles, deep blue and violet lighting, scale with tiny glowing mushrooms, photorealistic, ultra detailed, no text, no logos, no watermarks
caption: I think whales dream in colors we can't name. What would you find inside a glowing cave?
